senses.gloss: 2. अ॑र्च् m. (instr. अर्चा॑) fn. shining, brilliant [Gmn.], RV. vi, 34, 4.
अर्चक mfn. honouring, worshipping, Mn. xi, 224
अर्चक m. a worshipper, BhP.
अ॑र्चत् mfn. (pr.p.) shining, RV.
praising, RV.
अ॑र्चत् m. (अन्) N. of a Ṛṣi (son of Hiraṇyastūpa), Nir. x, 32 (commenting on RV. x, 149, 5).
अर्च॑द्-धूम mfn. whose smoke is shining, RV. x, 46, 7.
अर्च॑त्रि mfn. (said of the Maruts) roaring, RV. vi, 66, 10.
अर्चत्र्य᳙ (4) mfn. (fr. अर्चत्र, ‘praise’) to be raised, RV. vi, 24, 1.
अर्चन mf(ई)n. ifc. honouring, praising, Nir.
अर्चन nf. (अम्, आ) homage paid to deities and to superiors, MBh. &c. (cf. विबुधार्चन and सुरार्चन).
अर्चना॑नस् m. ‘who has a rattling carriage’, N. of a Ṛṣi, RV. v, 64, 7 and AV. xviii, 3, 15.

अर्च-नस् mfn. (fr. अर्चा below), ‘one whose nose is like that of an idol’, Kāś. & Pat. on Pāṇ. v, 4, 118. [The rule perhaps originally meant to explain the above N. अर्चना॑नस्, taking it for अर्चना॑नस्, ‘whose nose shows submission or devotion’.]
अर्चनीय mfn. to be worshipped, venerable.
अर्चस् n. worship, praise, L.
अर्चा॑ f. (Pāṇ. ii, 3, 43 and v, 2, 101) worship, adoration, ŚBr. xi; Mn. &c.
an image or idol (destined to be worshipped), VarBṛS. &c.
body, Jain.
1. आर्च mfn. (fr. अर्चा, Pāṇ. v, 2, 101) = अर्चावत् (q.v.), worshipping, doing homage.
2. आर्च mf(ई)n. (fr. ऋच्), relating to the Ṛc or Ṛg-veda.
अर्—˚चार्ह (MBh.), mfn. worthy of honour or praise
अर्—˚चार्हक (Bcar.), mfn. worthy of honour or praise
अर्चा—वत् mfn. (= 1. आर्च, q.v.) worshipped, Pāṇ. v, 2, 101, Sch.
अर्—˚चा-विडम्बना f. false or feigned worship, BhP.
अर्चा—विधि m. rules for worship or adoration, RāmatUp.
अर्चि॑ m. (chiefly Ved.) ray, flame, RV. &c.
(इस्), m. (for अंश) N. of one of the twelve Ādityas Comm. on KauṣBr.
अर्चि-नेत्राधिपति m. N. of a Yakṣa, L.
अर्चि—म॑त् mfn. (m. du. -म॑न्ता) shining, blazing, RV. x, 61, 15; MuṇḍUp.
अर्चि—व॑त् mfn. id., RV. vii, 81, 2 and ix, 67, 24.
अर्चिचयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of √ अर्च्) wishing to praise or worship, Kir.
अर्चित mfn. honoured, worshipped, respected, saluted, MBh.; Mn. &c.
offered with reverence, Mn. iv, 213 (अन्- neg.) & 235; Yājñ. i, 167
अर्चितिन् mfn. honouring (with loc.), (g. इष्टादि, q.v.)
अर्चितृ m. a worshipper, R. v, 32, 7.
अर्चि॑न् mfn. (said of Varuṇa's foot) shining, RV. viii, 41, 8
= अर्च॑त्रि, q.v., RV. ii, 34, 1 and v, 45, 1 N. of a man.
अर्चि॑स् n. ray of light, flame, light, lustre, RV. (once. pl. अर्ची॑न्षि, RV. vii, 62, 1), AV.; ŚBr. &c.
अर्चि॑स् f. id., ŚBr. ii; Up. &c., (इस्), N. of the wife of Kṛśāśva and mother of Dhūmaketu, BhP.
अर्चिष्-मत् mfn. brilliant, resplendent, R. &c.
अर्चिष्-मत् m. fire, the god of fire, Hariv.
a flame, VarBṛS.
अर्चिष्-मती f. one of the ten stages (through which a Bodhisattva must rise before becoming a Buddha), Buddh.
1. अर्च्य mfn. to be honoured or worshipped.
2. अर्च्य ind.p. See √ अर्च्
आर्चायन m. (fr. ऋच्, g. नडादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 99), a descendant of Ṛc
आर्चायन mfn. belonging to the Ṛg-veda [T.]
आर्चिक mfn. relating to the Ṛg-veda or connected with a Ṛc-verse
आर्चिक n. N. of the Sāma-veda.
आर्चीक m. patr. of Jamad-agni, Bālar.
आर्चत्क॑ m. (fr. ऋचत्क, Sāy.), N. of Śara, RV. i, 116, 22.
आर्चाभिन् m. pl. N. of a school founded by Ṛcābha (a pupil of Vaiśampāyana), (g. कार्तकौजपादि, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 37), Nir. &c.
आर्चीक-पर्वत m. N. of a mountain, MBh.
